title: Constant algebraic quotient models under explicit scalar realization
statement: For X,d,V,T as in [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data], with every T.level n perfect, the explicit realization [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-realization] of the etale constant T.level n is isomorphic to the specified completed constant model on each W. The comparisons intertwine the specified consecutive constant arrows with the model diagram arrows using the scalar compositor [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-coherence]. This assertion has no actual quotient system M or descended etale K.

source.place: Tag 09C6, the constant algebraic quotient model; Modules on Sites Tags 093J--093M and Cohomology on Sites Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Represent a perfect level by a bounded finite projective complex. Constants, universe transport and restriction commute on the representatives. The locally bijective finite scalar unit identifies associated fixed-ring modules with actual finite-ring modules. Completed constant flatness and canonical finite quotient identification identify the latter with completed extension of the underlying A-complex.

On each constant pure tensor, the two consecutive comparisons send the generator to the same section. Consecutive projection compatibility and associativity of restriction prove the normalized arrow square. Pass the equality through sheafification, total complexes and derived localization.

theorem finitePerfectAdicScalar_model
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (V : X.Etale) (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n)) :
    ∃ model : ∀ (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) (n : ℕ),
    (finitePerfectAdicScalarRealization X d V U W f n).obj
        ((localProEtaleComparison U.hom (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).obj
          (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant V.left T n)) ≅
      (finitePerfectAdicModelDiagram X d W T).obj (op n),
      ∀ (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) (n : ℕ),
    (finitePerfectAdicScalarRealization X d V U W f (n + 1)).map (localProEtaleNormalization U.hom
        (RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1)))
        (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstantTransition V.left T n)) ≫
      (finitePerfectAdicScalarCoherence X d V U W f n).hom.app
        ((localProEtaleComparison U.hom (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).obj
          (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant V.left T n)) ≫
      (model U W f n).hom =
    (model U W f (n + 1)).hom ≫
      (finitePerfectAdicModelDiagram X d W T).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
